authority: Income Tax Department, Government of India / Ministry of Finance

provisions.statutory_note: Amended by Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 raising new-regime standard deduction to Rs. 75,000 w.e.f. AY 2025-26.

provisions.formula: Minimum of: (1) Actual HRA received, (2) Rent paid minus 10% of salary, (3) 50% of salary (metro: Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai) or 40% (non-metro)
provisions.salary_definition: Basic salary + dearness allowance (forming part of retirement benefits)

provisions.description: Deduction for contributions to PPF, EPF, ELSS, life insurance premiums, home loan principal, etc.
Additional deduction for contribution to National Pension System (NPS)
Deduction for health insurance premium and preventive health check-up
Interest on borrowed capital for self-occupied house property
provisions.applicability: Old tax regime only; under Section 115BAC(2), loss under 'Income from house property' cannot be set off against salary

provisions.description: Rebate of income-tax in case of certain individuals

new_regime.marginal_relief_rule: Tax payable shall not exceed total income exceeding Rs. 7,00,000
Tax payable shall not exceed total income exceeding Rs. 12,00,000 (Finance Act 2025)

provisions.description: Special provisions governing the new tax regime for individuals and HUF
provisions.statutory_note: Default tax regime from AY 2024-25 onwards. Rate slabs updated by Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 and Finance Act 2025.

provisions.marginal_relief_rule: Total tax payable plus surcharge shall not exceed (tax plus surcharge payable on threshold income) plus (total income minus threshold income)

provisions.description: Rounding off of total income to nearest multiple of Rs. 10
Rounding off of tax payable to nearest multiple of Rs. 10
